decision: Flux GitOps instead of kubectl apply
why: The manifests lived in my shell history and in my head, which are two places I do not trust. With Flux the repo is the source of truth and the cluster gets pulled back to it if it drifts.
tradeoff: prune: true is also the flag that deletes your workload the moment you delete a file.

decision: Cloudflare Tunnel instead of opening router ports
why: I did not want to open a port and start advertising my front door. With a tunnel my router never has to accept an inbound connection at all.
tradeoff: Universal SSL only covers one subdomain level, so hostnames had to be flattened. Deeper names cost extra.

decision: Label nodes by what they can do, not by brand
why: When dell-node eventually dies, every workload asking for workload=heavy follows the label to whatever replaces it. Also, honestly, dell-node felt ugly in a YAML file.
tradeoff: One more thing to keep consistent when a node is rebuilt.

decision: Recreate strategy for single-replica apps with one volume
why: A rolling update deadlocks: the new pod cannot mount the volume while the old pod still holds it. On a single-replica homelab app with one RWO volume, that is exactly the right trade.
tradeoff: A few seconds of downtime on every deploy.

decision: Let the Helm chart generate the Ingress instead of writing it
why: I do not edit a chart. I give it values. The chart owns the Ingress, so an upgrade does not fight my hand-written copy.
tradeoff: A wrong value name does not fail. It just gets ignored.

decision: SOPS + age for secrets in git
why: A plaintext password in values ends up in git history forever. A Secret created by hand was a problem I had deferred, not fixed. Encrypting with SOPS before it goes near git fixes it.
tradeoff: One more key to protect. Lose the age key and every secret in the repo is unreadable.

decision: k3s default local-path storage, for now
why: It is the default in k3s and it is fast and free.
tradeoff: The volume is pinned to one node, so three nodes give that app no resilience at all. Shared storage and volume backups are on the roadmap.
